(e.g., "How empty is this node?" or "How many matching pods are already here?")

div.div:
The Weight (The "Multiplier"):
This is a measurement of importance.

div.div:
For each priority we calculate a point and
add them together to get the final
score of that node

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
If a node has 10 cores and 2 cores
are requested, it is 80% free.
The plugin looks at that 80% and says:
"I give this node a Score of 80."
Because the default internal Weight is 1, the final points for this plugin are: 80 x 1 = 80

div.div:
Score grows with the total size of the cached images (scaled by how many nodes have them).
Big image fully cached: near 100.
Nothing cached: Score = 0.
